messages:
devon_support: customer reports a streaming tool-call where the JSON args are cut off mid-stream when passing through their websocket + nginx ingress. They say ~40% of attempts fail parsing on the client side. cc @mike_infra @sarah_ops :help:

mike_infra: can you paste the raw stream fragment they captured? which proxy/version/region?

devon_support: here's the exact fragment from the client (they saved the stream frames):

repro-bot: ```
data: {"type":"tool_call","name":"fetch_invoice","args":{"invoice_id":"inv_1234","fields":["amount","date"]
data: {"type":"tool_output","text":"Fetching..."}
```

sarah_ops: that looks like the closing braces got dropped between frames. if the client strictly parses each `data:` block as a complete json object it will 400. did the connection drop or was there a retry?

devon_support: customer says no explicit disconnect, just a pause then next chunk arrives but their parser already threw. infra is nginx-ingress 1.9 behind a cloud LB. they provided proxy config with `proxy_buffering on` (default).

anya_engineering: quick note: our streaming runtime writes two sequential TCP writes here (args then trailing braces). many proxies will re-chunk or buffer; some clients parse every text chunk as standalone JSON which breaks if we split mid-object. we should either (a) make client SDK tolerant (reassemble until full json) or (b) ensure we emit clear boundaries (length-prefixed or sentinel) or (c) change server to avoid mid-object flushes for tool-call args.

mike_infra: can you reproduce in staging with nginx-ingress and the same config? if reproducible, we need a mitigation and then a proper fix. also collect tcpdump/pcap of ws frames.

devon_support: starting a repro job now. steps I used:
1) start a ws client that prints each `data:` chunk raw
2) run a simple tool-call that returns args in two writes (simulate long args)
3) route via nginx-ingress with `proxy_buffering on` and default `proxy_http_version 1.1`

repro-bot: repro job 1755551111-01 finished: reproduced. nginx re-chunked so client received a partial JSON object in one frame, parse error seen. attached logs (link): https://files.redwood/repro/1755551111-01/logs.txt

sarah_ops: tagging eng-runtime. @anya_engineering can you take the pcap + job id and triage? impact: customer cannot use streaming tool calls reliably behind certain ingress configs. possible user-facing 400s and failed workflows.

anya_engineering: got it. initial triage: parser should buffer until a full JSON object is available. we also should add a safe-guard to our tool-call handshake: if args parse fails, treat as "incomplete" and wait up to N ms for more stream data before returning 400. low-risk patch. long-term, consider adding a per-chunk length prefix or explicit `eos` token for tool-call payloads.

mike_infra: meanwhile, runbook for support: recommend customers set `proxy_buffering off` or enable `chunked_transfer_encoding` on their ingress, or use our non-streaming mode for tool-call invocations. I'll draft KB and send to support.

devon_support: customer gave permission for us to try a config change. I'll coordinate and test with them. thanks all. :thumbsup:

anya_engineering: opening eng-runtime issue: ER-3142 with repro job, pcap, and suggested quick patch. assigning to self.

devon_support: leaving thread open until a hotfix lands or we have a recommended stable workaround. will update customer with KB link and ETA.
